value_set_evolution_note: Per zh/conformance/schema-registry.md §6.1: entries carrying value_set_evolution='open' are open registry sets (adding a value is a backward-compatible minor; codegen SHOULD use non-exhaustive Unknown(String) fallback). value_set_evolution='schema_selector' registries are algorithm-agility token sources whose canonical-object selectors are frozen per schema version (codegen MUST generate per-schema-version closed types; adding an active value requires a schema version bump). Registries WITHOUT this field are simply not classified here (they may be structural sources such as the contract registry or manifest, or value sets not yet classified); consumers MUST consult §6.1 and the registry's own registry_rules rather than assuming a registry is or is not a codegen value-set source from the mere absence of this field.
